analysis: Integration of all batch analyses. The PR is documentation, tests and provider-local deadline-admission estimator changes: per-step decode shape pricing, an isolated-prefill anchor with a 1/8 floor, 30-minute idle evidence expiry, and newest-observation freshness in EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate. It adds the DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0 rollback switch, parsed fail-open to enabled and forwarded via LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys. The replayed patches (changelog, hardware-support.md, serving-performance-qualification.md, cli-reference.md row at head line 1687) are consistent with the per-unit analyses. Nothing touches coordinator-provider encryption (T-008), A-001/A-003 key custody, App Attest authorization (TB-011, T-053/T-054), prefix-cache storage (T-041 TTL, HMAC tags, cacheSalt scope) or the fan helper. The env passthrough is an explicit allowlist: the tests assert the key is absent from WatchdogAgent and unrelated secrets are excluded, so no widened env injection was found. The operator already controls the provider environment (TB-003, ADV-001), and the knob only alters local first-token admission timing (availability class, T-010/T-029), not authorization. Docs state that slot and process byte admission, actual deadline expiry and the platform memory contract still apply, and that published rates and wire fields are unchanged. Unverified: I did not inspect the resolve/decodeRateShape bodies in full or the callers. The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump (0351444 to e28f89d) is opaque and its diff was not supplied, so any effect on TB-007 inference, the prefix cache or memory handling is unreviewed. I request a deeper review of that submodule diff. Replay of source was incomplete (109 units omitted).
